system.description: The character reinforces their defenses with their mind.
system.trigger: A character using a telekinetic power that grants damage protection is attacked.
system.effect: The character can transfer any Health damage that gets through a telekinetic power that grants damage protection to their Focus instead, leaving the protection intact.

prerequisites.message: Telekinetic Reinforcement requires a target protected by a telekinetic damage-protection effect.

outcomes.label: Enter Focus equal to the Health damage being transferred, prevent that Health damage, and leave the selected telekinetic protection intact.
